newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates mostly unchanged.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly unchanged on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded versus no trades Friday. Bids and offers included:
- Two barges, Illinois, this week, no bid, offered 165 percent of tariff - unchanged.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi, this week, no bid, offered 180 percent - unchanged.
- One barge, md-Mississippi, next week, no bid, offered 180 percent - up five percentage points.
- Two barges, Illinois, next week, bid 150 percent, offered 160 percent - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi, one each week of April, bid 155 percent, offered 160 - both values unchanged.
- Eight barges, Mississippi (LaCrosse-Savage), two each week of April, bid 185 percent, offered 195 - both unchanged.
- Eight barges, Mississippi (LaCrosse-Savage), two each week of May, bid 165 percent - unchanged, no offer.
- Eight barges, Mississippi (St Paul-Savage), two each week of June, bid 155, offered 165 - both are down five points.
